hints.title: Rigid Motion Canonical Island Shape Normalization
hints.text: Two islands match if one can be rotated or reflected into the other across 8 planar symmetry transformations.

hints.title: Extracting and Transforming Connected Components
hints.text: Collect island cell coordinates using connected traversal. Generate all 8 transformed coordinate lists by applying reflections (x, y), (-x, y), (x, -y), (-x, -y) and 90 degree coordinate swaps.

hints.title: Canonical Island Representation Blueprint
hints.text: For each transformation: sort coordinates, translate by subtracting top-left coordinate, serialize into tuple. The lexicographically smallest serialization forms the canonical shape signature. Insert into a distinct shape collection.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every cell visited once in traversal; 8 coordinate transforms sort up to K points in O(K log K).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple translation alignment fails when islands are rotated 90/180/270 degrees or mirrored.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating all 8 symmetries produces canonical strings for constant factor comparison.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Normalizing shapes by sorting and relative translation across all 8 dihedral transformations.

solutions.approach: DFS with 8 Dihedral Symmetries Canonical Hashing
